title: Wiring the Test Harness into CI
description: A GitHub Actions workflow that checks out the repository, sets up Python 3.12, and runs test_runner.sh.

steps.description: The comment names the file, `.github/workflows/test.yml`. The workflow has one job, `test`, running on `ubuntu-latest`.
The steps check out the repository with `actions/checkout@v4`, then set up Python with `actions/setup-python@v5` at version `"3.12"`.
The last step makes `test_runner.sh` executable and runs it. The page says no additional configuration is needed, because the exit code from the script tells GitHub whether the job passed or failed.

steps.question: The page says `test_runner.sh` exits with `1` when any test fails. What do most CI systems treat a non-zero exit code as?
